jamal_cs: Drafting a 1-page "frictionless mobile handshake" runbook for customers with frequent reconnects and tight token budgets. Want something we can email and paste into kickoff docs.

jamal_cs: Big goals: avoid cold-token waste, keep UI responsive on flaky networks, detect renewal risk early and give CS quick mitigation steps.

jamal_cs: Short checklist (one paragraph each):
- Server-prefill: push 2 small prompts when a session starts so first client call is lighter.
- Batch vs concat: use concat (single prompt) when you want one coherent answer; use 2-3 small batches for independent items to parallelize.
- Offline buffer: clients should queue up to 4 messages and flush as a compact batch when reconnected (debounce 200-500ms).
- Streaming: only for live-typing UX. If network packet loss >8% prefer batch.
- Cache: prefix TTL 25s default for high-churn mobile; increase to 60s for low-churn apps.
- Quota watch: set a soft-alert at 80% of monthly token quota and a 'renewal_watch' flag if 3-day rolling avg > 65% of quota.

yuki_se: Adding two pasteable snippets for engineers (curl + one-liner to flip stream). Keep them tiny so PMs can include in emails.

yuki_se: ```
# small batch (curl) - good for queued flushes
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","inputs":["short prompt A","short prompt B"],"max_tokens":100,"stream":false}'

# SDK one-liner (pseudo) - enable streaming for live typing
await client.generate({model:'redwood-small', input:prompt, stream:true})
```

tara_sre: Ops notes to include in handout (bullet form):
- prefix_cache_ttl: 25s mobile / 60s enterprise.
- per-tenant concurrency: default 3 (can be reduced for constrained plans).
- warm-pool: pre-warm 1 node for anticipated launches (5-10m).
- fallback rule: if p50 latency >350ms for 45s, auto-reduce max_tokens by 30% for mobile header and prefer batching.

miles_pm: Renewal outreach copy (short, friendly): "Hi <name> We noticed rising token use and intermittent reconnects in your app. We can help tweak prompts or enable a short burst while you stabilize. Quick 15-min call or share a sample session?"

jamal_cs: Also adding CS mitigation checklist when renewal_watch triggers: 1) prompt concat audit, 2) reduce default max_tokens by 15%, 3) offer 48h burst credit, 4) prioritize warm-pools during peak windows. Attach token burn chart + last 7 days.

notify_bot: created Confluence page -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/frictionless-mobile-handshake (access: customer-success, product)

yuki_se: UX tip for streaming on flaky mobile: send a tiny (40-80 char) sync call to get first tokens, then open the stream for the rest; improves perceived latency.

tara_sre: health rule to add to dashboard: if reconnects >2 per session AND daily token burn increases >30% -> create 'engagement-risk' ticket for CSM.

jamal_cs: If no objections I'll publish this as the mobile kickoff handout and attach to the low-touch onboarding email. Please comment with edits by EOD.
